report:
# FQ-BUSCH-EFFECT-FRAME

Six explicit rational Pauli effects (I±X,Y,Z)/6 sum to I and provide informationally complete readouts of a supplied Hermitian 2x2 matrix. Actual coefficient arrays and trace products reconstruct all four coordinates. The finite halfspace cone is larger than PSD: the retained Hermitian candidate with both coherences1/2 passes the six probes yet has determinant -1/4 and negative rational quadratic witness. Invalid candidates are not called densities.

Supported: Exact six-effect readouts and reconstruction, plus a finite-probe-versus-PSD counterexample, are native/kernel checked at the stated scalar/coordinate scopes.

Remaining: Prove full effect positivity, matrix/trace transport, arbitrary Busch hypotheses and the separate real-place/Galois/SOS claims. Finite informational completeness alone is not full positivity or Born uniqueness.
